verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies a read-only PDF.js viewer, dashboard/email entry points, and an optional offline PDF download action.
The source approves an existing View Book button but does not add the NFT detail page as a viewer entry point; that button is covered by the narrower NFT-detail access Requirement.
First concrete navigation-control failure: the on-screen arrows faded and became unclickable while keyboard navigation still worked.
First concrete verification after the navigation-control failure: the client observed persistent visible controls and accepted their current behavior.
